# coefficients.json holds the thermodynamics for NB_GRAINS = 4 hexagonal grains, generated by
# ../test1/generate_coefficients.py -ng 4 --kvm 0.04015625 --kgm 0.04015625 --kvb 0.04015625
# --kgb 0.04015625 (Sum-based expressions, N-independent) with the parameters of test1 (Table 1
# of Aagesen et al. CMS 161 (2019) with the single soft curvature k = 2.57e9 J/m3 of Kim et al.
# 2022). Generate the C++ coefficient classes at configure time.
execute_process(COMMAND python3 ${BUILD_SCRIPT_DIR}/GenerateCoefficient.py -r  -f  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/coefficients.json
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

set(CURRENT_EXE FissionGas3Dtest4)
add_executable(${CURRENT_EXE} main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(${CURRENT_EXE} Sloth)
set_compile_options(${CURRENT_EXE})
add_dependencies(tests ${CURRENT_EXE})

# The hexagonal 3D mesh comes from generate_mesh.sh (make_hex_geo.py + gmsh -3 + finalize_mesh.py):
# see README.md in this directory. hex.msh has one physical volume "grain_1..4" per grain, a
# physical surface "box" on the outer faces, and a $Periodic section (after $Elements) pairing
# the opposite box faces in x, y and z; box size passed to the run with the -lx/-ly/-lz defaults.
configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/hex.msh ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/hex.msh COPYONLY)

# Short smoke run: 10 steps of dt=5 (AMR off, the estimator dominates the cost; use -amr for
# production runs). The specialized time files are appended to, not truncated, so a dirty
# Saves directory would corrupt the comparison.
add_test(
    NAME FissionGas3Dtest4
    COMMAND bash -c "rm -rf Saves && mpirun -np 2 $<TARGET_FILE:${CURRENT_EXE}> -noamr -t 50 -dtmin 5 -dtmax 5"
)
set_tests_properties(FissionGas3Dtest4 PROPERTIES LABELS "3D FISSIONGAS")

# Compare the bubble-phase inventory (columns 3-4, bit-reproducible) at tight tolerance, and
# the gas inventory + density of the MuGas problem at a looser one: the iterative solves are
# not bit-reproducible across runs (observed ~1e-4 relative in the energy/mu columns), and the
# mu columns are ~0 at early times where a relative criterion is meaningless.
create_col_comparison("CompareFissionGas3Dtest4" "op_time_specialized.csv"
    "Saves/Hex3D/OrderParameters_time_specialized.csv" "3;4" relativeEpsilon 1e-8 FALSE
    "FissionGas3Dtest4" "3D FISSIONGAS")

create_col_comparison("CompareFissionGas3Dtest4Gas" "mug_time_specialized.csv"
    "Saves/Hex3D/MuGas_time_specialized.csv" "3;5" relativeEpsilon 1e-2 FALSE
    "FissionGas3Dtest4" "3D FISSIONGAS")
